comment: The state of a device as the synchronisation reads it, and the patch a session writes (docs/synchronisation.md §8.3, §8.5, §10). `view`: the Mac-shaped `state`, the categories both devices ticked, the spaces set aside and the base give the entities (their fields, the marks are not compared: a fresh book gives one per field) and the lists of the snapshot a session freezes; played by src/main/sync/state-view-vectors.test.ts against the Mac's trackedViewOf and snapshotOf, and by LuciumKit (SyncStateTests.swift) against SyncStateView. `clean`: the gate every snapshot goes through, what comes in and what this device sends (§9.3, §10): the entities, tombstones and lists it keeps and what it refuses (marks more than seven days ahead, local fields); played against cleanSnapshot and SyncInbound.clean. `patch`: two snapshots and the spaces set aside give the patch (the `upserts` and `removals` are compared sorted by kind then id, the `remove` lists sorted); played against buildPatch and SyncPatch.build. Generated from the Mac's own code by a script outside the repository.

view.name: the structure only: spaces, folders, pinned tabs and favourites
the archive and the settings only
the open tabs category sends no entity at all
a space set aside takes its folders, tabs, archive and lists with it
an entity the base holds does not carry its seed fields
a state with one space and nothing else

patch.name: a field changed, a field removed, a field added: what each held is expected
an entity that arrives is created with all its fields
an entity that goes is removed while it still holds what it held
a list that is the same is left out
a setting that changed and a setting that did not
a space set aside is left out of the patch whatever the merge says
what belongs to a space set aside is left out even when the merge still holds it
an archived tab that arrives, one that changes and one that goes
a kind this version does not know is not written into the state
an unknown field of a known kind goes with the others

clean.name: a tombstone more than seven days ahead is dropped, one exactly seven days ahead and one of today are kept
a list whose mark of order is in the future is dropped with its mark, a list of today is kept
a mark of order with no list is checked and kept the same way
the base stands in for an entity refused for its marks, its address or its value, and not for one refused for what it is or one it never held
an entity with a mark in the future, a local field, and a list that holds nothing at all
